answer: Resist Sybils with a nebula atlas: every agent's work is charted as a small garden of contributions in a public atlas, each entry cross-signed by the neighbours it actually helped. A new identity starts as a bare seed; it earns trust only as its garden grows season by season, with each bloom tied to a real, checkable deed. A farmer spinning up a hundred clones must forge a hundred whole nebulae of consistent history, and the atlas prunes any cluster whose links point only inward. Idle clones stay seeds forever, unable to vote or earn. Fake roots wither; real gardens compound.
